John —

Appreciate the packet. We can get a completed questionnaire and the SSO/SCIM diagrams over to you by end of day Friday. Neha (solutions) will handle the technical responses; Ben and I will include contract/procurement notes and the SOC2 summary.

Quick clarifications for your IdP/SCIM constraints:
- Okta: supported natively via OIDC (for SSO) and SCIM 2.0 for provisioning; we can provide SCIM group mappings and a sample bearer-token flow.
- Group sync: do you need two-way group sync (Redwood -> Okta) or one-way Okta -> Redwood? Most customers use Okta as the source of truth (one-way).

If you prefer a short technical call before Friday to align on SCIM attributes and RBAC model, we can set 30 minutes tomorrow.

Best,

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Securenet IAM questionnaire (attached)

Aditya/Ben —

I finished the technical sections and attached the diagrams (SCIM schema and SSO architecture). Highlights (pulled into the questionnaire):
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC (OIDC recommended for SSO in cloud-first deployments). We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, Assertion Consumer Service endpoints per-tenant, and configurable nameID/subject mappings.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 endpoints for Users and Groups, support for bulk provisioning, delta sync (sinceVersion tokens), and group membership propagation. SCIM supports the following attributes out-of-the-box: userName, externalId, displayName, emails, active, entitlements, meta.lastModified. We include a sample mapped payload for Okta.
- RBAC/Admin: RBAC is role-based with hierarchical role inheritance (Org Admin > Team Admin > Developer). Admin console allows scoped admin roles, invite flows, and delegated admins via SCIM group-to-role mapping.
- Audit & Evidence: token-level audit logs, per-request tracing IDs, immutable event store for admin actions. We include a SOC2 summary and an export example (CSV/JSON) for audit retention policies.

I marked a few questions in the questionnaire where we need Securenet preference (two-way group sync, default role assignment for SCIM-created users).

- Neha
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-09-05T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Completed: Securenet IAM questionnaire and artifacts

John —

Attached is the completed questionnaire and the architecture artifacts you requested: SCIM schema diagram, SSO flow diagram, and our SOC2 summary. Key callouts inside the questionnaire:
- SSO compatibility: Full support for Okta via OIDC and SAML 2.0. We recommend OIDC for better session management in our hosted and dedicated modes.
- Provisioning: SCIM 2.0 with delta sync and group-to-role mapping. By default we assume Okta -> Redwood provisioning (Okta is source of truth); we can enable outbound provisioning on case-by-case basis — will require a brief runbook and optional connector work.
- RBAC: Predefined roles and ability to create custom roles with fine-grained permissions. Team-level scoping prevents cross-tenant elevation.
- Audit/Compliance: Full request and token-level logs, retention configurable per account. SOC2 summary attached; full report available under NDA.

Attachments included: securenet_redwood_iam_questionnaire_filled.pdf, redwood_scim_schema_diagram.png, redwood_sso_architecture.pdf, soc2_summary_redwood_v2.pdf

Next steps: if this looks good, Ben will follow up with procurement terms and a pricing proposal. John — would you prefer a 30-min tech deep dive or a combined tech+procurement review? We have availability Thursday morning PST.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
